verdict.rationale: Text content was extracted from coloradosos.gov guidance pages (business filing, name reservation, foreign entities, starting a business) and from tax.colorado.gov. That shows the public reading surface was crawlable and served real text rather than a JS-only shell or CAPTCHA. Probe-2 explicitly says the tax.colorado.gov guidance pages remain open and are in the crawled corpus; the mytax portal failure was a DNS resolution error on a filing portal, not a bot wall on guidance pages. missing for 10: an explicit probe of the guidance pages recording HTTP status and the identified user agent, and confirmation that no bot-challenge layer applies across the full coloradosos.gov reading surface.
